svg.title: The oracle screen, recreated as a wireframe
svg.desc: A wireframe of the oracle's window, laid out from the live app (1040 by 760 points) with a plain circle standing in for the bot's avatar. It plays one real turn, timed from a recording of the oracle: a question is typed and sent, the bubble slides up, a working line reads Checking system storage with a sweeping shimmer, the bot's short reply lands above it, the line changes to Typing, the answer arrives and the line leaves. The bot's computer sleeps on the right, its z's rising. The typing and the loop reset are ours. With reduced motion it shows the finished turn, still. Generated by scripts/generate-hero.mjs.

text.tspan: How much storage do you have, and where?
I’ll check how much storage I have on my computer.
I have 38 GB free of 75 GB. It is all on my own computer, a
small Linux machine in a data centre in Nuremberg. Most of the
space goes to the system and my work folder, and about 2 GB is
browser cache I can clear. Want me to clear the cache and old
